app.placeholder: Select a session on the left to connect, or open a local terminal

sidebar.empty: No sessions yet. Click + to add one.
sidebar.openHint: Double-click to open in a new tab
sidebar.resizeHint: Drag to resize, double-click to reset
sidebar.folderHint: Double-click to open all its sessions
sidebar.deleteMessage: Delete the session “{name}”? Its saved password is removed from the keychain too.
sidebar.openAllMessage_one: This opens {count} tab for the sessions in “{folder}”.
sidebar.openAllMessage_other: This opens {count} tabs for the sessions in “{folder}” and its subfolders.

tabs.forwardsHintFailed: Show/hide the port forwarding panel ({shortcut}). Some rules failed to start.

terminal.restartHint: Press Enter to start a new shell
terminal.reconnectIn_one: Reconnecting in {count} second. Press Enter to reconnect now or Ctrl+C to cancel.
terminal.reconnectIn_other: Reconnecting in {count} seconds. Press Enter to reconnect now or Ctrl+C to cancel.
terminal.reconnectCancelled: Automatic reconnection cancelled. Press Enter to reconnect.

profile.name: Name
profile.passwordAskPlaceholder: Leave empty to be asked when connecting
profile.passwordHint: Passwords are stored in the system keychain.
profile.keyHint: If the key has a passphrase, you will be asked in the terminal when connecting.
profile.agentHint: Uses the keys loaded in the system SSH agent.
profile.invalidPort: Port must be an integer between 1 and 65535
profile.keepaliveHint: 0 turns keepalives off. The connection is considered lost after 3 unanswered keepalives.
profile.autoReconnect: Reconnect automatically when the connection is lost
profile.invalidKeepalive: The keepalive interval must be an integer between 0 and 3600
profile.autoHint: Tries the SSH agent's keys and ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_ecdsa and id_rsa, then keyboard-interactive or password, as ssh does.
profile.passwordAutoHint: Used if the server asks for a password. Passwords are stored in the system keychain.
profile.jumpHostsHint: Connects through these sessions in order, like ProxyJump.

sftp.notConnectedYet: Remote files are available once connected
sftp.pathHint: Type a path and press Enter
sftp.replaceMessage:
These items already exist and will be replaced:
{names}
sftp.deleteFolderMessage: Delete the folder "{name}" and everything in it? This cannot be undone.
sftp.chmodInvalid: Permissions must be 3–4 octal digits, e.g. 644 or 0755

forwards.title: Port Forwarding
forwards.empty: No forwarding rules yet. Rules are saved with this session and can start automatically when it connects.
forwards.profileMissing: This session has been deleted, so its forwarding rules are no longer available.
forwards.notConnected: Rules can be started once connected.

explain.local: Connections to {bind} on this computer are forwarded through the server to {target}.
explain.remote: Connections to {bind} on the server are forwarded through this computer to {target}.
explain.dynamic: A SOCKS proxy at {bind} on this computer; applications using it connect through the server.

dialog.exposedLocal: Other computers on your network will be able to connect to this port.
dialog.exposedRemote: Servers only listen on non-loopback addresses when GatewayPorts is enabled.
dialog.invalidBindPort: The listening port must be an integer between 0 and 65535
dialog.invalidTarget: A destination host and a port between 1 and 65535 are required

forwards.quickConnection: Port forwarding rules are saved with a session. Save this connection as a session (tab menu) to use them.

importDialog.title: Import from SSH Config
importDialog.empty: No hosts found. Only Host entries without wildcards can be imported.
importDialog.hint: Jump hosts are imported along with the hosts that use them. Port forwards are imported without auto-start.

settings.title: Settings
settings.fontHint: Missing characters, such as Chinese, fall back to system fonts.
settings.copyOnSelect: Copy text as soon as it is selected
settings.rightClickHint: Shift+right-click always shows the menu, also in programs that use the mouse.
settings.confirmMultilinePasteHint: Not asked when the shell supports bracketed paste, which inserts the lines without running them.
settings.optionAsMetaHint: Option+B, Option+F and similar shortcuts reach the shell, but Option no longer types special characters.
settings.followRemoteTitle: Show the title set by the shell
settings.followRemoteTitleHint: Otherwise tabs show the session name. Renamed tabs keep their new name.
settings.confirmClose: Ask before closing tabs that are connected or running a program
settings.zmodemAskLocation: Ask where to save files received with sz
settings.zmodemAskLocationHint: Otherwise they are saved in the Downloads folder.

closeConfirm.title: Close Tab?
closeConfirm.connected: “{name}” is still connected. Closing the tab ends its session.
closeConfirm.process: “{process}” is still running in “{name}”. Closing the tab ends it.
closeConfirm.processUnknown: A program is still running in “{name}”. Closing the tab ends it.
closeConfirm.many: Some of these tabs are still connected or running a program.
closeConfirm.window_one: {count} tab is still connected or running a program. Closing the window ends it.
closeConfirm.window_other: {count} tabs are still connected or running a program. Closing the window ends them.

paste.title: Paste Multiple Lines?
paste.message_one: The text ends with a line break, so it may run as a command as soon as it is pasted.
paste.message_other: The text has {count} lines. Each line may run as a command as soon as it is pasted.

zmodem.waitingForFiles: rz is waiting: choose files or drop them here
zmodem.transferring: ZMODEM transfer running. Ctrl+C or Cancel stops it.
zmodem.chooseFolderTitle: Choose where to save the received files

sessionImport.title: Import Sessions
sessionImport.hint: Jump hosts are imported along with the sessions that use them, or matched to existing sessions. Folders are merged by name. Passwords are not part of the file.
